shortDescription: Philippine inflation eased to 6.1% in August, its fourth straight monthly slowdown, while remaining above the central bank’s target, according to Bloomberg.The moderation reflected slower increases in utility rates and food prices.

title: Philippine Inflation Slows to 6.1% After Repeated Rate Hikes
